description:
From the fz-kdt.107 cold review census (2026-09-01): 12 of the 17
runtime-indistinguishable groups are the closure-identity shape --
discriminating_inputs finds nothing, the plan emits ZERO tests, and a
bare source-order fallthrough routes EVERYTHING to arm 0. Arms 1..n are
therefore provably unreachable by construction, while their executables
are still specialized, lowered, and shipped: dead specializations, a
proportional-compilation cost (and misleading artifact content). Two
directions: stop lowering provably-unreachable arms (measure inventory
drop across the 10 census fixtures), or fold the sibling minting
upstream (fz-kdt.107 option B territory -- coordinate). Also the
natural home for fz-kdt.117 item (3) (if-joined closures
incomplete-semantic-plan -- triage it against this shape first).
This is documented POLICY today (callable correlation is
runtime-unobservable; source-ordered selection) -- the policy may stand;
the dead lowering does not have to.
title: 12 no-question dispatch groups emit zero tests: arms 1..n are unreachable by construction yet fully lowered
